payload.reasoning_summary: FASE-1 is the earliest incomplete phase. Its canonical-encoding prerequisite is absent, and ADR-009 must define the unresolved encoding decisions before any StateHash or SaveHash implementation. This is the smallest dependency-opening unit and is preferred over later ledger, RNG, Electron, and packaging work.
risks: An incomplete ADR could freeze an ambiguous format and later invalidate replay or save compatibility.
Unbounded or accidentally admitted JavaScript object types could introduce runtime- or platform-dependent encodings.
The repeated history of passing but uncommitted encoder work indicates a process risk outside implementation correctness.

acceptance_criteria: ADR-009 is committed and specifies the encoding bit-for-bit, including encodingVersion framing, type tags, length framing, UTF-8 object-key ordering applied recursively, integer and bigint representations, ordered and unordered collection treatment, supported value types, duplicate/collision handling, and all rejection cases.
packages/core exports canonicalEncode(state, encodingVersion) returning Uint8Array and CanonicalEncoderError.
Logically equal supported states, including states whose object properties were inserted in different orders, encode to byte-identical output.

Each tested logically distinct state encodes differently, including bigint 1n versus number 1, different nesting, different collection kinds, and values that would collide under delimiter-free concatenation.
Changing encodingVersion changes the encoded bytes for the same state.
Undefined, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, negative zero, unsafe integer numbers, cyclic structures, and every value type excluded by ADR-009 throw CanonicalEncoderError.
Unordered collections encode identically across insertion orders according to ADR-009; ordered collections preserve order and encode differently when order changes.
No StateHash, SaveHash, RNG, ledger, world, application, or Electron implementation is introduced.
Repository typecheck, lint, existing architecture-boundary checks, and the complete existing test suite pass.
must_preserve: All existing determinism lint rules and tests remain green.
All existing package dependency-boundary rules and tests remain green.
packages/core remains independent of world, domain, application, adapters, UI, and Electron packages.
Encoding is deterministic and does not depend on locale, runtime object insertion order, current time, randomness, native object hashing, or platform endianness.
No hash of state exists before ADR-009 and the canonical encoder are accepted.
task.objective: Commit ADR-009 and a deterministic, versioned canonical encoder in packages/core that provides unambiguous bytes for supported state values before any state hash is introduced.
out_of_scope: StateHash, SaveHash, cryptographic or non-cryptographic hash functions.
Positional RNG and RNG namespace definitions.
Nominal economic types, rounding helpers, ledger behavior, Electron, packaging, or CI installer changes.
Supporting state value types not explicitly admitted by ADR-009.
Changes to CICLO_SPEC.md or unrelated packages and tooling.
required_adrs: ADR-009: normative canonical encoder format and supported value domain
required_tests: Unit test logically equal recursively nested states with different object insertion orders produce identical bytes.
Unit tests for distinct primitives, type distinctions, nesting distinctions, and length-framing ambiguity cases producing distinct bytes.
Unit test bigint 1n and safe-integer number 1 produce distinct bytes.
Unit tests undefined, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, negative zero, unsafe integer numbers, cyclic references, and ADR-excluded types each throw CanonicalEncoderError.
Unit tests ordered collection reordering changes bytes and unordered collection insertion-order changes do not.
Unit test changing encodingVersion changes bytes.
Run the repository typecheck, lint, architecture-boundary validation, and full test commands.
scope: Write docs/decisions/0009-canonical-encoder.md with a complete normative wire format, supported value domain, recursive UTF-8 key ordering, numeric representations, collection ordering, version inclusion, and error behavior.
Implement and export canonicalEncode(state, encodingVersion): Uint8Array from packages/core.
Implement and export a dedicated CanonicalEncoderError.
Use explicit type and length framing so distinct supported values and structures cannot share an encoding through concatenation ambiguity.
Reject unsupported or non-canonical values, including undefined, NaN, positive and negative Infinity, negative zero, unsafe number integers, and cyclic structures.

Add focused unit tests for deterministic equality, structural distinction, recursive key ordering, numeric type separation, collection ordering, version separation, invalid values, and ambiguous-boundary cases.
